pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for.

files.description: List of PDF files or directories to search.

use_perl_regex.description: Interpret pattern as a Perl compatible regular expression (PCRE2).

ignore_case.description: Ignore case distinctions in both the PATTERN and the input files.

only_matching.description: Print only the matched part of a line without any surrounding context.

count.description: Suppress normal output and print the number of matches for each input file.

page_range.description: Limit search to a specified set of pages (e.g., '1-3,5').

include_glob.description: Only search files whose base name matches this GLOB.

exclude_globs.description: List of GLOB patterns to skip files.

recursive.description: Recursively search all files under each directory.

after_context.description: Print NUM lines of context after matching lines.

before_context.description: Print NUM lines of context before matching lines.

use_cache.description: Use a cache for the rendered text to speed up operations.

quiet.description: Suppress all normal output to stdout; exit 0 if match found.
